title: serve_bundle_lane marks zero-unit packets as serviced, silently excluding genuinely waiting packets from the residency (b) term
detail: The append is unconditional: once avail hits 0 mid-lane, trailing FIFO packets get give==0 yet are flagged in-service, so their waiting ticks vanish from (b). The F2 pin (waited==7 behind a head consuming the full budget) then fails.
recommended_fix: Append only when give > 0 (or break the walk when avail == 0) so zero-unit packets still accrue residency (b).

title: bundle_tx_window indexes the ring with unvalidated dir while its write twin and port_residency_ticks guard bounds
detail: dir is an unbounded u8; a dir >= PORT_DIR_COUNT makes base+s read out of bounds. Record guards the composite index; the read and port_residency_ticks' key check do too — this one is the inconsistent outlier.
recommended_fix: Mirror the record-side guard: reject dir >= PORT_DIR_COUNT (or check base+s < len) before the slot walk.

title: Serialize comment claims 'old logs replay unchanged' while the diff's own header admits S2/S4 shifted runs were re-blessed
evidence:
serialize.odin: "events are REGENERATED while the action log is commands — LOG_VERSION stays 6
and old logs replay unchanged). The S4 re-bless covers the byte shift."
egress_test.odin: "(T1 byte-identity held at S1: zero
//   re-bless; S2/S4 shifted runs re-blessed per the disclosed inventory)."
detail: Re-blessed goldens mean old contended logs replay to numerically different outcomes (streaming transit 8→16 ticks, D-2 'DELIBERATE balance change'); 'replay unchanged' is format-compatibility only and reads contradictory here.
recommended_fix: Qualify the serialize comment: 'old logs load and replay under LOG_VERSION 6; contended replays diverge numerically per the disclosed re-bless.'
